newsitem.title: USA: E.W. Scripps to proceed with merger talks.
newsitem.headline: E.W. Scripps to proceed with merger talks.

text.p: E.W. Scripps Co said Tuesday that shareholders voted to give it the authority to proceed, "at its discretion," with the proposed merger of its cable television systems with Comcast Corp.
Under an agreement reached in October 1995, Comcast proposed to acquire the systems in exchange for shares of Comcast stock, which would be distributed tax-free to Scripps shareholders.
Scripps said its board of directors has the option to terminate the merger if Comcast's average share price is below $17.06 and Comcast declines to increase the number of shares to be delivered.
